remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST MONDAY 1/19 12PM. This is a home you'll feel connected to the moment you walk through the door. Warm, inviting, and beautifully maintained, this updated ranch offers a layout that truly lives comfortably. The main level features hardwood floors, a cozy living room with a classic fireplace, and a spacious dining area perfect for family dinners or entertaining friends. Sunlight pours into the living/playroom, creating a cheerful space for relaxing, working, or playtime. The kitchen has been updated with new stainless steel appliances, and the full bath has been recently renovated. Two well-sized bedrooms and a brand new washer/dryer complete the main floor, making daily living effortless. The lower level is a major bonus-recently updated with new flooring, a beautifully redone full bathroom, washer/dryer and a large living/rec room that offers endless possibilities. Two additional finished rooms provide flexible space for a home office, guest area, gym, or future bedroom conversion. Outside, enjoy a large, fully fenced backyard with a generous patio-perfect for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing at the end of the day. With an attached garage, brand new central AC system, and thoughtful updates throughout, this home has been cared for with true pride. Located in a desirable Norwalk neighborhood, you're walking distance to schools and just minutes from the train, I-95, and the SoNo Collection.
